- agents.md:1203-1206 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The auto-generated workflow tree does not include .github/workflows/apply-analysis-on-main.yml and .github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml.
  WHY: `make generate-check` runs `tools/repo_tree/update_repo_tree.py --check`, which reports agents.md out of date and blocks the merge.
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: lines 224-249 (tracking-issue poll loop with 1800s timeout) vs lines 215-219 (workflow dispatch) vs lines 252-264 (label + marker comment written only after the tracking issue appears) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The pending label and source-document marker are written only after a tracking issue appears, so the 30-minute wait can time out before the orchestrator creates that issue.
  WHY: A subsequent push finds neither guard and dispatches the same analysis document again, creating duplicate orchestrator projects and duplicate release candidates.
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: lines 218-253 (the wait loop computing new_json = after - before over open ai:orchestrator-tracking issues, then labelling new_json[0]) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The script can associate a newly created unrelated tracking issue with the dispatched analysis document based only on the before/after issue-set difference.
  WHY: An unrelated orchestrator run can be labelled `ai:comprehensive-test-pending` and receive the source marker, causing the foreign project to drive the comprehensive release callback while the real project remains unlabelled.
- agents.md:915-916 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The five new stable log prefixes are present in the human-readable bullet list but absent from the machine-readable LOG_PREFIX.name= registry block.
  WHY: Consumers that parse the contractual LOG_PREFIX.name= block will not recognize APPLY_ANALYSIS_SKIPPED, APPLY_ANALYSIS_DISPATCHED, AUTO_RELEASE_SKIPPED, AUTO_RELEASE_DISPATCHED, or IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_TERMINALIZED; x-ai_grok-4_6 classified this as NIT while the other reviewers classified it as MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: the test-invocation steps (for example 367-666) enumerate python3 tests/*.py files explicitly | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py, tests/test_auto_release_stable.py, and tests/test_implement_blocked_verdict_terminalizes.py are not wired into CI.
  WHY: CI does not execute the 8 + 8 + 2 tests cited by the PR, so regressions in the new workflow and terminalization behavior can merge undetected.
